title: HOLD-LC-001 response-owner field contract from official Fermi semantics
question: Can the official Fermi GS-005/GS-006 and rsp/rsp2 semantics be converted into a precise source-owner request for response selection, calibration validity and timing uncertainty without silently choosing an interpolation or likelihood?
method: Read the official Fermi GBM data-access, response-documentation and science-product-format references, recording URLs and retrieval date rather than copying source text or raw data.
Crosswalk those role definitions against the exact local POSHIST, SPECHIST and N0/B0 rsp2 manifests already frozen in EXP-001305 and EXP-001306.

Write a candidate-neutral owner request contract that requires versioned segment selection/interpolation, calibration validity/linkage, time-standard and detector-to-geocenter conversion, uncertainty, statistical ownership and holdout separation.
Explicitly forbid treating segment numbering, product-role labels or a published summary as a likelihood, covariance or physical dynamics selection.
Preserve the established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order and parked-loop rules; do not read response values or score candidates.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite source-role semantic crosswalk and owner-field contract; no table-value reading, likelihood evaluation, continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 contract refinement; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

official_roles.GS-005: GBM gain and energy-resolution history required for calculating detector response matrices.
official_roles.GS-006: Fermi position and attitude history used in the response pipeline.
official_roles.rsp: A single detector response for a source position and time interval.
official_roles.rsp2: A response file containing multiple detector response matrices for changing pointing or time segments.

local_exact_products.position_attitude: EXP-001305 FERMI-GBM-EVENT-DAY-POSHIST-ALL; hash-pinned GLAST POS HIST headers and TT-second coverage.
local_exact_products.spectral_history: EXP-001305 FERMI-GBM-EVENT-DAY-SPECHIST-N0/B0; hash-pinned GBM SPEC HIST headers and TT-second coverage.
local_exact_products.response_history: EXP-001306 FERMI-GBM-EVENT-TRIGGER-RSP2-N0/B0; one EBOUNDS and eight numbered SPECRESP MATRIX headers per detector over the trigger window.

source_crosswalk.semantic_boundary: The official descriptions explain product roles and response segmentation, but they do not supply this project with a source-owned validity/interpolation rule, geocenter timing correction, uncertainty, joint likelihood or covariance.

checks.detail: The three official Fermi references are primary documentation and their role statements are recorded as bounded paraphrases with direct locators.
The crosswalk points only to the previously hash-pinned POSHIST/SPECHIST/rsp2 manifests; no raw bytes or table values were copied.

The request contract turns the semantic gap into explicit acceptance fields for segment selection/interpolation, calibration validity/linkage, time standard, geocenter conversion, uncertainty, likelihood/covariance and holdout.
T-054/T-059 methods, R-192 owner order, stopped-loop registry and promotion firewalls are unchanged.

finding: Official documentation confirms that GS-005/GS-006 are calibration and position/attitude inputs to the GBM response pipeline and that rsp2 carries multiple time/pointing-specific response matrices. This supports a precise owner request, not a likelihood admission: the project still lacks the versioned validity/interpolation rule, detector-to-geocenter timing conversion, uncertainty, joint statistical owner and intrinsic-emission treatment.
decision_reason: This is a new semantic crosswalk and durable acceptance contract tied to exact local hashes, not a repeated generic search or a model test. It makes the next owner gate executable while explicitly preventing an implicit interpolation or statistical promotion.
decision_scope: T0 official-document semantic crosswalk and candidate-neutral owner-request contract only; no matrix-value inference, event likelihood, candidate ranking, dynamic identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The official URLs and retrieval date identify the documentation used for role semantics.
EXP-001305 and EXP-001306 remain authoritative for local product hashes and header-only observations.
A role description is not a source-owned implementation, and an rsp2 segment list is not an interpolation law.
The existing estimator contract, T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned response-segment validity/interpolation and calibration-to-response linkage.
Source-owned TT/MET/GPS/geocenter conversion and uncertainty for GBM and GW timing.
Frozen detector, energy, background and time windows with selection and missing-data rules.
Joint likelihood or covariance with calibration, shared-source and intrinsic-emission nuisance terms.
Complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs maps, immutable scorer and sealed prospective holdout.

adversarial_review.check: Could official product-role descriptions be treated as a source-owned timing likelihood or covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: documentation is used for semantics only; statistical ownership remains missing.

adversarial_review.check: Could the presence of rsp2 segments justify silently choosing the nearest or center-time DRM?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the request contract requires a versioned, pre-registered selection/interpolation rule before any score.

adversarial_review.check: Could TT-second header coverage be treated as detector-to-geocenter timing and uncertainty?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: conversion and uncertainty are explicit missing physical-owner fields.

adversarial_review.check: Could GS-005/GS-006 labels be called microscopic dynamics or QFT/Yang-Mills evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: they are calibration/position provenance roles only.

adversarial_review.check: Could the request contract replace the existing proof lanes?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is additive T-061 intake and preserves T-054/T-059 methods and owner order.

boundary: EXP-001307 is a T0 official-source semantic and owner-contract advance. It does not admit response values, calibration validity/interpolation, detector-to-geocenter conversion, timing likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 primary official-document crosswalk plus hash-pinned local owner candidates; no model or statistical test
next_action: Use the request contract to locate or obtain source-owned response-segment validity/interpolation, calibration linkage, detector-to-geocenter conversion and uncertainty. Keep response values and scoring locked; independently reproduce F_reg only after the acceptance fields are frozen, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake.
stop_or_redesign: If the required owner fields cannot be obtained, retain HOLD-LC-001 as provenance/design-only and do not score.
If future analysis reads response values, issue a new version with an explicit candidate-neutral uncertainty and leakage contract.
If no dynamic observable separates a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, regulator or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If retrospective data are used to tune after target disclosure, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
Official documentation and exact product headers do not provide a source-owned likelihood, covariance, geocenter correction, nuisance law or complete observation map.
This contract does not establish a causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity or microscopic dynamics.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; the owner request is additive and not a replacement.
